name: tamga
description: Verify tamga proof chains and delivery attestations independently. verify_ledger checks a ledger.jsonl end-to-end (prev-link + JCS canonical-hash + seq) with no tamga install; ledger_head returns the chain tip; verify_attestation checks a CAPACITY_ATTEST_V1 delivery claim with the three-verdict contract (green/red/indeterminate); verify_charge checks a single charge record's chain membership; verify_bundle checks all seals of a relayer fulfill bundle (fnv1a64 stamp, TSG1 snapshot, JCS payload, keccak-256 delivery). Every tool returns a JSON verdict and never raises.

tools.name: verify_ledger
tools.description: Verify a tamga ledger.jsonl proof chain end-to-end, independently.

tools.name: ledger_head
tools.description: Return the current chain tip (last h, 64-hex) of a valid ledger.

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: Verify an external CAPACITY_ATTEST_V1 delivery attestation (green/red/indeterminate).

tools.name: verify_charge
tools.description: Verify a single charge record's chain membership: h == sha256(prev + jcs(record-h-less)).

tools.name: verify_bundle
tools.description: Verify all seals of a relayer fulfill bundle in one call.

privacy.keys: No secrets. The server shells out to tamga's own stdlib CLI verifiers and returns their JSON verdicts.
privacy.network: None. All verification is local reads of files the caller provides.
